mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downwards.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the GDP growth is negative, or if the correlation between negative GDP growth and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a strong supply-side response, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased production capacity supports economic growth and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and a decrease in retail sales signals a shift in consumer spending from goods to housing, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate increased economic activity.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases & RSAFS decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls by more than 100,000 in a month signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth prospects diminish.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between PAYEMS decreases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the consumer price index by more than 0.5% in a month signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real returns are eroded and the Federal Reserve may tighten monetary policy.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales and a decrease in the unemployment rate signals a strengthening consumer demand environment, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and employment improve.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases & UNRATE decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
